SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. D. REGISTRY
B. D. 685.
21. 1. 32.
Shanghai Jan 20th 1932

Capt. Gerard :
Commissioner of Police :
Shanghai Municipal Council :

Dear Sir :

I, the undersigned, British
subject, 21 years of age, educated from
local Convent, can speak fluent Shanghai
dialect, desires to seek position as
girl - detective or female police searcher.
Has no previous experience, salary desired
$ 60. a month.

Hoping to receive a reply at
your convenience,
I am
(Knie)
Dear Sir,
Your obedient servant
Lizzie Langston

上海，1932年1月20日

杰拉德（Gerard）上尉：
警务处处长：
上海公共租界工部局：

尊敬的先生：

本人，下述签名人，英国籍，
21岁，毕业于本地修道院学校，能讲流利的上海
方言，欲谋求女侦探或女性搜身警员之职位。
此前无工作经验，期望月薪
60美元。

盼能在您方便时予以回复，
此致
(Knie)
尊敬的先生，
您顺从的仆人
莉齐·兰斯顿（Lizzie Langston）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D REGISTRY
No. I. G. D. 688
Date 14 - 12 - 29

Shanghai, 11 Dec. 1929.
20 Route Prosper Paris.

To the Director,
"Criminal Investigation Department",
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Dear Sir,
Being tired of leading an idle social life and as am
ambitious for a detective career, therefore, am willing to offer
my service free as "female searcher". I do not want to receive
any salary, as am one of those fortunate few who does not have to
earn my own living, as my parents are wealthy enough to support
me.

Hoping to receive a favourable reply at your
convenience,

I remain,
Dear Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Miss. L. Langster

File Recd
19/12

Sir
File attached. 11/12.
M.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记处
编号 I. G. D. 688
日期 29年12月14日

上海，1929年12月11日。
巴黎繁荣路20号（Route Prosper Paris）。

致主任，
“刑事侦缉处”，
上海公共租界工部局。

尊敬的先生，
因厌倦了无所事事的社交生活，且本人
有志于从事侦探职业，故愿免费提供服务，担任
“女性搜身员”。我不希望领取
任何薪水，因为我是少数幸运儿之一，无需
自谋生计，我的父母足够富有，可以供养
我。

盼能在您方便时给予 favorable 回复，

此致，
尊敬的先生，
您顺从的仆人，
L. 兰格斯特（Langster）小姐

档案收到
12月19日

先生
附件已归档。12月11日。
M.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. L. 685.
Date 26.-11.-29.

November 26, 29.

Dear Madam,

With reference to your application for a
position as a female searcher, I regret to inform you
that there is no suitable vacancy for you in this Department
at present.

Yours faithfully,

A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

Miss. L. Sangster,
20 Route Prosper Paris,
Shanghai.

Shanghai, November 25, 1929.
20 Route Prosper Paris.

To
Detective Inspector Mr. H. Robertson,
Room No.312 Police Headquarters,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

Dear Sir,

I shall be much obliged if you will be kind enough
to give me a definite reply, if whether my application will be

favourable reply at your earliest convenience,

I remain,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

POLITICAL BRANCH
(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 11. 10. 29
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

D. 685
File No.
Crim □□y
No 171

Sir,

With reference to that attached letter of October
1, 1929 from Miss L. Sonster, inquiries show that she
is the daughter of Charles Sonster, a British subject,
employed as a □arfin□er by Messrs I□i□mon, M□chen□ic
& Co. for P & O ships. Miss Sonster in appearance is
more Chinese than anything else and was educated at the
Institution of the Holy Family in Shanghai (now in
Quincern Road) which she left three years ago since which
time she has been unemployed. She speaks the Shanghai
and Soochow dialects fluently and has an excellent
knowledge of written and spoken English.

Miss Sonster seems to have no special qualifications
for the position of a "female office-searcher" unless
it be her knowledge of English. She appears to be
somewhat simple. Attached is a letter from this
office by her in response to a request for references.

A. Roluston
D. I.

Jleter
11/10

W.S. C. I.

11/10/29

（外籍股）
日期 29年10月11日
(刑事侦缉处) 办公笔记

D. 685
档案编号
刑事 □□y
第 171 号

先生，

关于所附1929年10月1日 L. 森斯特（Sonster）小姐的来信，经查询，她
是查尔斯·森斯特（Charles Sonster）的女儿，后者为英国籍，
受雇于 I□i□mon, M□chen□ic & Co. 公司，为 P & O 轮船公司服务，职位为 □arfin□er（原文不清）。森斯特小姐在外貌上
更像中国人，曾在上海的圣家会机构（Institution of the Holy Family）（现位于
昆山路 Quincern Road）受教育，三年前离校，此后一直
失业。她能流利地说上海话和苏州
话，并具有极好的英语读写能力。

除非凭借其英语知识，否则森斯特小姐似乎不具备
担任“女性办公室搜查员”的特殊资格。她看起来
有些单纯。随函附上本办公室应其要求提供的
推荐信副本。

A. 罗鲁斯顿（Roluston）
督察长

Jleter
10月11日

W.S. C. I.

29年10月11日

From V.Vizenzinovich
c/o CONSULADO DE ESPAÑA
227 BUBBLING WELL ROAD
TELEPHONE 85110.

Shanghai, 8 October 1929
Detective Inspector Mr Robertson,
Shanghai Municipal Police
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

At the request of Mr Charles Sangster, British subject. I have to inform
you that I have known him and his wife for many years and that Miss
Lizzie Sangster is their oldest daughter and that they are all re-
sidents of Shanghai.

Yours truly
V. Vizenzinovich

上海公共租界工部局警务处
上海。

尊敬的先生，

应英国籍人士查尔斯·桑格斯特（Charles Sangster）先生的请求，特此通知
您，我认识他和他的妻子多年，莉齐·桑格斯特（Lizzie Sangster）小姐是他们的长女，他们均为

此致
V. 维曾齐诺维奇（Vizenzinovich）

Shanghai, October 1, 1929.

Captain R.M.J. Martin,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

Dear Sir,

I, the undersigned, highly-educated, prominent society
girl, British Subject, 22 years of age, can speak fluent Shanghai
dialect, very intelligent, well acquainted with Chinese affairs,
and well known in Shanghai Chinese social circles, desires to
seek position as girl-detective (female police searcher).

Hoping to receive a reply at your earliest
convenience,

I remain,
Dear Sir,
Your most obedient servant,
[签名难以辨认]

（批：for Sec:
Who is she. See her
& ask why vc vc.
2/10 [签名]）

Miss. Lizzie Sangster,
20 Route Prosper Paris,
Shanghai.

上海，1929年10月1日。

R.M.J. 马丁（Martin）上尉，
副警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局，

尊敬的先生，

本人，下述签名人，受过高等教育，出身名门社交界的
女士，英国籍，22岁，能讲流利的上海
方言，非常聪明，熟悉中国事务，
在上海华人社交圈中颇有名气，欲谋求
女侦探（女性警察搜身员）之职位。

盼能在您最早方便时予以回复，

此致，
尊敬的先生，
您最顺从的仆人，
[签名难以辨认]

（批注：致秘书：
她是谁。见她
并询问为何 vc vc（原文不清）。
10月2日 [签名]）
